clubs.name: Maison Opal
clubs.tagline: Iridescent couture for the first city of Opalia.
clubs.description: A collection of 7,777 couture avatars. Every holder gets a residence in Opalia and a seat at the Saturday runway.

clubs.name: Satin Swans
clubs.tagline: Ballet-core avatars. Phipad class of spring.
clubs.description: Soft-silhouette avatars with a shared pavilion world. Incubated and funded through Phipad.

clubs.name: Velour Vixens
clubs.tagline: Night-out AR looks with authentic ownership.
clubs.description: Each Vixen unlocks a wearable AR look, verified to its holder in every camera that supports Phiegg ownership.

clubs.name: Lumen Lynx
clubs.tagline: Agentic cats running a desert fashion city.
clubs.description: Every Lynx is an agent with a wardrobe, a job and a reputation in Lumen Mesa.

worlds.name: Opalia
worlds.description: A tidal city of shell-white boulevards where every facade is a boutique.

worlds.name: Velour Veil
worlds.description: An AR layer over real streets: look up and the city is wearing Velour.

worlds.name: Lumen Mesa
worlds.description: A desert city run by 10,000 agent citizens who design, trade and gossip.

worlds.name: Swan Lake Pavilion
worlds.description: A single glass pavilion on a still lake. Performances every full moon.

worlds.name: Acro World
worlds.description: Aerial runways strung between floating towers; every look is judged mid-air.

worlds.name: Nebula
worlds.description: A drifting star-cloud city where fabrics are woven from light.

worlds.name: Naimia
worlds.description: A sunlit capital of ateliers and rooftop salons, home of Naim City.

worlds.name: Satin Reef
worlds.description: An underwater promenade of satin kelp and pearl-lit boutiques.

worlds.name: Carousel
worlds.description: A spinning fairground city where every ride ends on a runway.

worlds.name: Couture Coast
worlds.description: A seaside strip of flagship houses and tidal fitting rooms.

worlds.name: Velvet Dunes
worlds.description: Desert dunes that ripple like crushed velvet at dusk.

worlds.name: Glasshouse
worlds.description: A greenhouse metropolis where plants and garments grow together.

worlds.name: Silk Atlas
worlds.description: A map-shaped world; each continent is a different weave.

worlds.name: Pearl Ridge
worlds.description: Mountain terraces of nacre and cloud-level showrooms.

worlds.name: Runway Isle
worlds.description: One island, one endless runway, one ocean of audience.

worlds.name: Aurum
worlds.description: A gilded city where the streets are literally gold leaf.

worlds.name: Sequin Sea
worlds.description: A glittering ocean with floating sequin rafts for parties.

worlds.name: Chiffon Heights
worlds.description: Sheer skyscrapers that sway like chiffon in the wind.

worlds.name: Neon Atelier
worlds.description: A night city of glowing sewing rooms and AR street drops.

worlds.name: Tulle Valley
worlds.description: Soft valleys of layered tulle where ballet avatars rehearse.

worlds.name: Obsidian Bay
worlds.description: A black-glass harbor for monochrome purists.

worlds.name: Cashmere Peaks
worlds.description: Snow peaks with fireside lounges and knit chalets.

worlds.name: Gilded Grove
worlds.description: A forest of golden trees hung with jewelry.

worlds.name: Prism Port
worlds.description: A trading port where light splits into seasonal palettes.

worlds.name: Organza
worlds.description: A translucent city you can see straight through.

worlds.name: Brocade
worlds.description: An embroidered city stitched together block by block.

worlds.name: Ivory Tower
worlds.description: A vertical city of ivory salons and quiet libraries.

worlds.name: Orchid Rain
worlds.description: A monsoon city where umbrellas are the main accessory.

worlds.name: Solstice
worlds.description: A world with one endless golden hour.

worlds.name: Moonlace
worlds.description: A lunar city of silver lace domes.

worlds.name: Starling
worlds.description: A murmuration city that reshapes itself every night.

worlds.name: Crystalline
worlds.description: A frozen palace world carved from clear crystal.

worlds.name: Ember Coast
worlds.description: Volcanic beaches and molten-orange evening wear.

worlds.name: Halo
worlds.description: A ring world orbiting a runway sun.

worlds.name: Mosaic
worlds.description: A patchwork city where every tile is a creator’s shop.

worlds.name: Plume
worlds.description: A feathered sky city for statement headwear.

worlds.name: Kaleido
worlds.description: A shifting-pattern city that never looks the same twice.

worlds.name: Rosegold
worlds.description: A blush-metal city of evening parties.

worlds.name: Verdigris
worlds.description: An aged-copper city of green patina towers.

worlds.name: Oasis Nine
worlds.description: The ninth oasis: palm lounges and resort wear.

worlds.name: Echo Bloom
worlds.description: A garden city where flowers repeat your outfit back to you.

worlds.name: Saffron Sands
worlds.description: Spice-colored deserts and caravan boutiques.

worlds.name: Indigo Drift
worlds.description: A slow-river city dyed deep blue.

worlds.name: Coral Arcade
worlds.description: An arcade reef of pop-up stalls and game-show runways.

worlds.name: Midnight Mall
worlds.description: A mall that only opens after midnight.

worlds.name: Glimmer
worlds.description: A tiny world, entirely made of highlights.

worlds.name: Marquee
worlds.description: A theater-district world of premieres and red carpets.

worlds.name: Loom
worlds.description: A world-sized weaving machine run by agent weavers.

worlds.name: Cobalt Cove
worlds.description: A deep-blue cove of yacht fashion and dock parties.

worlds.name: Petal Park
worlds.description: A park world where every bench is a fitting room.

worlds.name: Aria
worlds.description: A concert-hall world where outfits are scored like music.

worlds.name: Zephyr
worlds.description: A wind-swept world of flowing silhouettes.

worlds.name: Topaz Terrace
worlds.description: Stepped terraces of amber gems and sunset lounges.

worlds.name: Lustre
worlds.description: A polished world where every surface is a mirror.

worlds.name: Nimbus
worlds.description: A cloud city of soft tailoring and rain-proof silk.

worlds.name: Veranda
worlds.description: A world of porches, garden parties and linen.

worlds.name: Gossamer
worlds.description: A spider-silk world strung between moons.

worlds.name: Paisley
worlds.description: A swirling print city of teardrop districts.

worlds.name: Bijou
worlds.description: A jewel-box world small enough to hold in AR.

worlds.name: Atelier Nine
worlds.description: Nine ateliers, nine agents, one collaborative world.

worlds.name: Ribbon Rise
worlds.description: A spiral city tied together with ribbon bridges.

worlds.name: Sable
worlds.description: A dark-fur-free luxe world of velvet nights.

worlds.name: Quartz Quarter
worlds.description: A clear-stone district of watchmakers and minimalists.

worlds.name: Lumen Gardens
worlds.description: Bioluminescent gardens that light the night runway.
